arxiv-2105-03264.title: SOME RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN 5TH FORCE SEARCHES
arxiv-2105-03264.creator: Ephraim Fischbach a,b, Dennis E. Krause c,a, Megan H. McDuffie a, and Michael J. Mueterthies a
arxiv-2105-03264.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ephraim Fischbach a,b, Dennis E. Krause c,a, Megan H. McDuffie a, and Michael J. Mueterthies a. Recently we drew attention to the fact that most recent 5th force searches and tests of the weak equivalence principle (WEP) utilize only one or two pairs of test samples. We argue that, despite the great precision of these experiments, the lack of diversity of samples may mean they are unable to detect new composition-dependent forces, which requires the observation of a pattern in the data.

arxiv-2210-10636.title: Improving Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Text-Matching Recommendation Systems
arxiv-2210-10636.creator: Parikshit Bansal, Yashoteja Prabhu, Emre Kıcıman, Amit Sharma
arxiv-2210-10636.description: Abstract Given a user’s input text, text-matching recommender systems output relevant items by comparing the input text to available items’ description, such as product-to-product recommendation on e-commerce platforms. As users’ interests and item inventory are expected to change, it is important for a text-matching system to generalize to data shifts, a task known as out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization.

arxiv-2401-06910.title: InRanker: Distilled Rankers for Zero-shot Information Retrieval
arxiv-2401-06910.creator: Thiago Laitz, Konstantinos Papakostas, Roberto Lotufo, Rodrigo Nogueira
arxiv-2401-06910.description: Abstract . Despite multi-billion parameter neural rankers being common components of state-of-the-art information retrieval pipelines, they are rarely used in production due to the enormous amount of compute required for inference. In this work, we propose a new method for distilling large rankers into their smaller versions focusing on out-of-domain effectiveness.

arxiv-2405-18416.title: 3D StreetUnveiler with Semantic-aware 2DGS - a simple baseline
arxiv-2405-18416.creator: Jingwei Xu, Yikai Wang, Yiqun Zhao, Yanwei Fu, Shenghua Gao
arxiv-2405-18416.description: Abstract Unveiling an empty street from crowded observations captured by in-car cameras is crucial for autonomous driving. However, removing all temporarily static objects, such as stopped vehicles and standing pedestrians, presents a significant challenge. Unlike object-centric 3D inpainting, which relies on thorough observation in a small scene, street scene cases involve long trajectories that differ from previous 3D inpainting tasks.

arxiv-2406-08429.title: A Sticker is Worth a Thousand Words: Characterizing the Use of Stickers in WhatsApp Political Groups in Brazil
arxiv-2406-08429.creator: Philipe Melo, João M. M. Couto, Daniel Kansaon, Vitor Mafra, Julio C. S. Reis, Fabricio Benevenuto
arxiv-2406-08429.description: Abstract With the increasing use of smartphones, instant messaging platforms turned into important communication tools. According to WhatsApp, more than 100 billion messages are sent each day on the app. Communication on these platforms has allowed individuals to express themselves in other types of media, rather than simple text, including audio, videos, images, and stickers.

arxiv-2411-04115.title: Condensing and Extracting Against Online Adversaries
arxiv-2411-04115.creator: Eshan Chattopadhyay, Mohit Gurumukhani, Noam Ringach, Rocco Servedio
arxiv-2411-04115.description: Abstract We investigate the tasks of deterministically condensing and extracting randomness from Online Non-Oblivious Symbol Fixing (oNOSF) sources, a natural model of defective random sources for which it is known that extraction is impossible in many parameter regimes [AORSV, EUROCRYPT’20].

arxiv-2503-05879.title: Cohomology of Restricted Twisted Heisenberg Lie Algebras
arxiv-2503-05879.creator: Yong Yang
arxiv-2503-05879.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yong Yang. Over an algebraically closed field 𝔽 \mathbb{F} of characteristic p > 0 p>0 , the restricted twisted Heisenberg Lie algebras are studied. We use the Hochschild-Serre spectral sequence relative to its Heisenberg ideal to compute the trivial cohomology. The ordinary 1- and 2-cohomology spaces are used to compute the restricted 1- and 2-cohomology spaces and describe the restricted 1-dimensional central extensions, including explicit formulas for the Lie brackets and − [ p ] -^{[p]} -operators.

arxiv-2504-11965.title: Mode locking via delayed orthogonal-polarization reinjection in semiconductor lasers
arxiv-2504-11965.creator: T. Wang 1 , Y. Ma 1 , Z. Li 1 , Y. Li 1 , Z. Tu 1 , Y. Zhang 1 , G. Xu 2 , S. Baland 3 , S. Xiang 1 , Y. Hao 4
arxiv-2504-11965.description: Abstract We demonstrate harmonic mode-locking in a semiconductor laser using orthogonal-polarization reinjection via an external ring cavity integrated with a rotatable λ \lambda /2-plate. By tuning the plate angle θ \theta , we achieve precise control over pulse multiplicity and repetition rates in orthogonal TE/TM modes.

arxiv-2506-16232.title: Osiris revisited: Confirming a solar metallicity and low C/O in HD 209458 b
arxiv-2506-16232.creator: N. Bachmann, L. Kreidberg, P. Mollière, D. Deming, S.-M. Tsai
arxiv-2506-16232.description: Abstract HD 209458 b is the prototypical hot Jupiter and one of the best targets available for precise atmosphere characterisation. Now that spectra from both Hubble Space Telescope (HST) and James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) are available, we can reveal the atmospheric properties in unprecedented detail.

pmc-11382058.title: Emotional AI in education and toys: Investigating moral risk awareness in the acceptance of AI technologies from a cross-sectional survey of the Japanese population
pmc-11382058.creator: Manh-Tung Ho, Peter Mantello, Quan-Hoang Vuong
pmc-11382058.description: Emotional artificial intelligence (AI), i.e., affective computing technologies, is rapidly reshaping the education of young minds worldwide. In Japan, government and commercial stakeholders are promulgating emotional AI not only as a neoliberal, cost-saving benefit but also as a heuristic that can improve the learning experience at home and in the classroom.

pmc-11393306.title: Counting everyone: evidence for inclusive measures of disability in federal surveys
pmc-11393306.creator: Jean P Hall, Kelsey S Goddard, Catherine Ipsen, Andrew Myers, Noelle K Kurth
pmc-11393306.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The US Census Bureau has used the American Community Survey six-question set (ACS-6) to identify disabled people since 2008. In late 2023, the Census Bureau proposed changes to these questions that would have reduced disability prevalence estimates by 42%. Because these estimates inform funding and programs that support the health and independence of people with disabilities, many disability researchers and advocates feared this change in data collection would lead to reductions in funding and services.

pmc-11456599.title: Evidence for SARS-CoV-2 infected Golden Syrian hamsters (Mesocricetus auratus) reducing daily energy expenditure and body core temperature
pmc-11456599.creator: Björn-Patrick Mohl, Claudia Blaurock, Alexander Riek, Catherine Hambly, John R. Speakman, Anne Balkema-Buschmann
pmc-11456599.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Golden Syrian hamsters (Mesocricetus auratus) are a well-established animal model for human infections with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) due to their susceptibility to SARS-CoV-2 infection, robust virus replication and pathological manifestations similar to human COVID-19 pneumonia. To investigate the physiological changes upon infection in this animal model, we explored the alterations in daily energy expenditure (DEE), water turnover, body mass, body temperature, and locomotor activity in non-infected and SARS-CoV-2 infected Golden Syrian hamsters for four days post SARS-CoV-2.

pmc-11624677.title: Transperineal Drainage of Seminal Vesicle Abscess Under Local Anaesthetic: A Case Report
pmc-11624677.creator: Ali Hooshyari, Flavio Vasconcelos Ordones, Lodewikus Petrus Vermeulen
pmc-11624677.description: A 44-year-old healthy Caucasian gentleman presented with fevers and right lower quadrant pain. He had mildly elevated inflammatory markers and computed tomography demonstrated cystic enlargement of the right seminal vesicle concerning for seminal vesicle abscess (SVA). SVA is a rare diagnosis and generally requires drainage for adequate source control.

pmc-11649795.title: Novel approach for Arabic fake news classification using embedding from large language features with CNN-LSTM ensemble model and explainable AI
pmc-11649795.creator: Omar Ibrahim Aboulola, Muhammad Umer
pmc-11649795.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The widespread fake news challenges the management of low-quality information, making effective detection strategies necessary. This study addresses this critical issue by advancing fake news detection in Arabic and overcoming limitations in existing approaches. Deep learning models, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), EfficientNetB4, Inception, Xception, ResNet, ConvLSTM and a novel voting ensemble framework combining CNN and LSTM are employed for text classification.

pmc-13079521.title: Zero-shot pseudowords memorability via representational content analysis
pmc-13079521.creator: Daniele Gatti, Fritz Günther
pmc-13079521.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Novel strings of letters (i.e., pseudowords) lack established meaning(s), yet they may still evoke systematic, distributional signals that influence human behavior. Here, we tested whether distributional determinants of word memorability generalize to these novel strings. To do so, we leveraged a word-embedding model that was able to represent in a vector space not only attested words but also unmapped strings as bags of character n-grams.

pmc-13092041.title: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver presenting as a complex mixed solid-cystic hepatic lesion in a young adult: A case report
pmc-13092041.creator: Emily Leung, Shabnam Islam, Matthys Van Wyk, Zi Qin Ng, Soo Yeon Kim, Tze Khor, Lingjun Mou
pmc-13092041.description: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver (UESL) is a rare and aggressive primary hepatic mesenchymal malignancy, predominantly affecting children aged 6-10 years but occasionally arising in young adults. Diagnosis is clinically challenging owing to paradoxical and nonspecific imaging features that vary across modalities, contributing to misdiagnosis rates of up to 23.5%.

pmc-13163882.title: Self-Refining Segment Anything Model for Nuclei Segmentation as Contrastive Learning Approach to Label-Efficient Pathological Imaging
pmc-13163882.creator: Siwoo Nam, Sang Hyun Park
pmc-13163882.description: Background/Objectives: Precise nuclei instance segmentation is a prerequisite for reliable digital pathology, yet the scarcity of pixel-level annotations remains a significant bottleneck for deep learning models. Methods: We propose a self-evolving framework for robust nuclei segmentation that uses only sparse point annotations, extending the Segment Anything Model (SAM).
